steps.name: Welcome. In this guide I give you a fairly optimal questing and skill training route for starting a Main or a new alt
feel free to deviate from it and if you encounter any mistakes pls dm me on discord: Max / he box jonge#0494
VERY IMPORTANT: If you want to make this alt into a slayer lure alt, DO NOT complete the following quests:
Dragon Slayer 1, Priest in Peril, Elemental workshop, Contact!, Death Plateau, Olaf's quest, Cabin fever, Regicide and Desert Treasure
Note on Magic training: When away from PC, if possible, fire strike/bolt sand crabs on hosidius beach (Chrome remote desktop / Mobile) (NPC aggression timer)
Once you get 55 magic you can also alch during questing, goal is 82 for magic imbue OR 75 on an alt
Best item to alch: Rune arrows
Use quest helper plugin on RuneLite for optimal questing!
This does not inlcude all quest items, just buy them as you get around to do each quest
Account start (main/alt) > Spec transfer OR Blood rc / runner alt
Slayer alt + wyvern/rd/bbd > Wyvern alt > Brutal Black drag
Runedragons/DS2
If you want to make a wyvern or brutal alt I recommend just following "Account start" and "Slayer alt"
Vyrewatch alts can be made from scrath from the "Vyrewatch" tab
Dont make the email: rsn@gmail.com or w/e
Make an unique recovery email, and use a password manager
Enable authenticator, on both your account and email

sections.section: Early game quests and NMZ unlocks

steps.name: Bond up + 1 extra bond for gp if starting out fresh
Make your way over to the GE or trade over teleport tabs and some ring of wealths (5) + GP (ring of the elements is around 1m gp and is very useful for early game quests)
Start X marks the spot, rune mysteries and restless ghost. trade over eye of newt, burnt meat, onion, all 4 beads and a necklace of passage + some stamina pots
Do X marks the spot (lamp on magic) and visit zeah once, imp catcher, witch's potion and complete rune mysteries and restless ghost
Get 43 prayer (POH or wildy)
Get 30 construction
1 - 15 (84 planks + 300 steel nails, build bookcases at lvl 4)
15 - 30 (184 oak planks, build workshop at lvl 15 and make oak repair benches)
Move your house to Hosidius for Mage sand crabs (make sure you have visited zeah once)
Do witch's house (Bring ~20 earth strikes to get lvl 13, fire strike/bolt all quest bosses from now on)
Druidic ritual (bring the 4 meats and ores for dorics quest)
Doric's Quest
Knights sword
Get 10 fletching (arrows)
Tourist trap (both rewards on agility)
Dwarf cannon
Waterfall quest
Tree gnome village (khazard warlord nmz)
Grand tree (5 kudos)
Fight arena
Monks friend
Hazeel cult (5 kudos)
Get 21 thieving (steal cakes)
Tribal totem
Plague city
Biohazard
Vampire slayer (count draynor in nmz)
Enter the abyss miniquest
Do zeah quests on w330 and use some1 elses house for xeric talisman teleports
Client of kourend (favour on Piscarilius and one lamp on rc other on slayer)
Get 20% hosidius favour
Depths of despair (sand snake nmz)
Temple of the eye
get 35 rc at GOTR
Murder Mystery
Merlins crystal (5 kudos + 1k xp lamp from museum on slayer)
Get 10 herblore (6 guam(unf), 6 eye of newt, 21 marrentill(unf), 21 unicorn horn dust, keep the antidotes for quests)
The Digsite
What lies below (king roald nmz) + bring the dagon hai book to the museum for 5 kudos
Museum quiz + cleaning finds = 100 kudos (after you got the clean necklace, buy ruby enchant tabs and ruby necklace to get some digsite pendants)
Bone voyage
Fossil island unlocked
Start doing birdhouse runs on your main account. Get atleast level 44 but more wont hurt.
Alt Note: With 26 craft and 29 con you can now make drift nets for 400-500k gp/h (can get 61 craft here if planning on doing lunar diplomacy)
If you are not tight on gp you can cut gems later on but 61 craft with drift nets profits you 3,5 - 4,5m gp compared to cutting rubies
[ALT] can also do birdhouses from now on if you want to do mm2 (60 hunt)
Get 28 (11k xp) crafting (Best leather item to 20, sapphires to 11k xp)
Jungle potion
Shilo village (should get you to 31 crafting)
Get 36 wc
Lost city (tree spirit nmz) (get multiple dramen staves + 2 dramen branch for Koschei the deathless in Frem trials and sir amik varze subquest)
Get 30 firemaking
Sea slug
Holy grail
Get atleast 43 pray
Monkey Madness 1 (choose att and defence training)
Get 40 Woodcutting
Get 40 Crafting (gems)
Get 25 fletching (arrows/darts during the quest)
Fremennik trials
Sell ring of the elements if you need gp
Eyes of Glouphrie (12k magic, 6k rc xp, crystal saw)
Watch tower (15k magic xp, requires 40 mining)
61 craft if you didnt do drift nets to 61 (cut rubies)
49 firemaking (ge or varrock tele fm)
67 magic (splash or alchemy room in mta or something else)
60 mining (iron or mlm) (3tgranite/iron on main if you know how)
55 woodcutting (afk willow or teak) (on main 1.5t/2t teaks if you know how)
Lunar diplomacy (NPC contact unlock)
You can probably get to this point with ~20 - 25h of playtime (excluding 0time mage training)
Your alt now has a good foundation to be upgraded in to one or more of the alts listed below
1. slayer lure alt (speeds up slayer by a lot and makes it more fun)
1.1 after slayer lure you can make it into rune dragon, wyvern or brutal black dragon alt
2. spec transfer alt (speeds up early slayer and gives a lot of melee xp in late slayer)
3. blood rc alt (500-600k gp/h)
4. vyre watch alt (500-600k/h but VERY AFK)
slayer alt: Requires a decent amout of gp ~50 - 100m depending on gear. very easy to kill wyverns or rune dragons afterwards
spec transfer: Either splash the magic lvl or make tele tabs, string jewellery at lvl 80 to speed it up
Blood rc alt: Takes around 60 hours to start rcing
vyrewatch alt: Recommend making this after you got 85 slayer if you only have 1 alt. Get 30 thieving and continue from line 24 on the vyre sheet
[MAIN ONLY] IF you followed this guide on your main you can start working on your other skills now while making on of the alts listed above
Recommended start:
If you are not 82 magic, alch during agility and keep splashing as 0time
56 agility (for shortcut in GOTR) Varrock course > buy graceful gloves and cape > do shaziyen adv. course @48 > wildy course @52 DONT FORGET SUMMER PIES!@!@
Get Raiments of the eye outfit + abyssal needle (Quest up your alt during GOTR, train/play the alt during mud rc)
Buy ring of the elements from GE
Start crafting Mud runes at the Water altar (see the sheet for gp/hr figures).
Note: steam runes at the fire altar are also a viable option. slightly more xp but less profit
Once you have 100m GP get 99 craft with air b staves. 100m allows you to buy 11k staves+orbs (4.5h of crafting). go back to rc when selling takes a while
Mud runes pre 99 vid: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nd7ukpqbfmg
